Diagnosis from the post-merge CI-speed thread (Claude session, 2026-10-26): **this is not a flake. It is a deterministic red on `main` since #25745 (4a).**

4a deleted `ui/.github/workflows/changeset-release.yml`, the release lane that moved to the root. Three ui script tests still read that file, so they fail on every run that schedules Test UI:

- `scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts`: Test UI 8/16. ENOENT on `ui/.github/workflows/changeset-release.yml`, and `ci-cd-pipeline.md` still lists the workflow (#25864).
- `scripts/__tests__/workflow-cache-save-bound.test.ts`: Test UI 9/16. "changeset-release.yml must still define a `release:` job" (#25862).
- `scripts/__tests__/check-pre-install-import-graph.test.ts`: Test UI 8/16, "a script this repository runs before `pnpm install` needs `node_modules` to load". Not yet confirmed to share the cause.

Same failures in runs 40248884869, 40251065567 and the queue build 40251505048 (jobs 121344335725, 121344335769). The fix belongs with the 4a follow-ups (#25711): drop or retarget those rows to the root release lane. ⛔ Do not quarantine.

## Epic PM reconciliation 2026-10-26T01:54Z — the anchored test is fixed on `main`; the remaining Test UI 8/16 red is another file · `session_01RSDL3SFtJaKzcymvCD8RsU`

Reason line, from the queue builds this anchor counts: `AssertionError: the "Workflow Inventory" table has rows for workflows that are NOT in .github/workflows/` — an assertion on tree content, not a timeout. Cause: #25745 (4a, cutover sitting) deleted `ui/.github/workflows/changeset-release.yml` and `spec-range-floors.yml`; `ui/content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` and this test still listed them. Deterministic on every tree since `2a61f08093`, so every queue entry inherited it (the `stack` column above reads correctly: one root, the rest bystanders). Not a flake, not a semantic conflict between queued PRs.

Fix: #25861 (4b PR 2c, Part of #25712) — merged 2026-10-26T01:49Z as `c475b45b56`. `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` reads 85/85 on that tree (PR run on head `9eea93b18b`; the same file was 9 failed on `main` `e167956e`). `workflow-cache-save-bound.test.ts` (Test UI 9/16, same cause) is fixed by the same PR.

Still red after it, and ⛔ not this anchor's file: Test UI 8/16 keeps ONE failure, `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-pre-install-import-graph.test.ts` › "finds no pre-install gate reaching a package" (`unresolved: scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs` — ten nested `ui/.github/workflows/*` still call a deleted script). That is a true finding on the tree, owned as the first row of 4b PR 2d on #25712 (Tier H: it deletes `ui/.github/workflows/**`). Until 2d lands, Test UI 8/16 stays red on `main` and in queue builds; it is not a required context, so the queue keeps merging. If the triage workflow refiles an anchor, it will name `check-pre-install-import-graph.test.ts`, and that anchor's answer is #25712 2d.

Closing as completed with the fix above. Part of #25677 (cutover aftercare).

- **Not a flake:** a deterministic red on `main` since #25745 (4a), per the diagnosis on #25864 (6406463458). 4a deleted `ui/.github/workflows/changeset-release.yml`, and these ui script tests still read it. They break `Test UI` 8/16 and 9/16 on every schedule run and eject queue entries. #25862, #25863 and #25864 are one cause. #25863's link is not yet confirmed, and the fix PR confirms or splits it.
